resources.string: Glass and dot colour are compiled per style, so every launcher sees a clean, static icon pack. Pick a combination, install that build, then select it once in your launcher.

1 Install the style build you picked.

2 Open your launcher settings → Icons / Icon pack.

3 Choose “Matrix · %1$s”. Icons apply instantly, no reboot.

Nothing OS 5.0 (Android 17) keeps its own icon pipeline. Install a launcher from the list above, or use Nothing’s “Apply to Home screen only” flow where your build exposes it. The pack is 100% offline: no permissions, no network, no trackers, no background services.
